capabilities: Batch-summarize PDF files into structured markdown notes using OpenAI GPT models
Create new concept notes from selected text with a command
Initialize a working folder structure in the vault
Optionally delete processed PDF files after summarization
extras: Recommends starting a new vault to avoid conflicts; summarization actually runs through an external Python script (summary_pdf_folder.py) configured via terminal environment variables, not purely inside Obsidian; recommends the Image Converter plugin for image compression.
motivation: Minimize efforts for lazy note-takers: summarize all PDFs in a folder before readings and define concepts during readings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate LLM summaries of PDF files or to turn selected text into linked concept notes automatically.

relations.evidence: summarize all PDF files in a folder to your vault with the power of LLMs (like GPTs from OpenAI)

requires.name: Python environment (with openai, arxiv, pymupdf packages)

summary: AI plugin that batch-summarizes PDFs into structured markdown notes via OpenAI GPT and creates concept notes from selected text.
